clue.text: Politician's order regularly placed with landlord

indicators.note: placed with means the two pieces are set side by side, the first ahead
regularly means taking every other letter of the word order, its second and fourth

parts.note: a publican is the landlord of a pub

explanation.surface: A politician gives orders at regular intervals while sharing a table with the pub landlord.
explanation.definitionFit: A Republican is a member of a party such as the US Republicans, hence a politician.

clue.text: Call for help stocking supplement for dull and boring people

indicators.note: stocking means holding something inside, as a shop stocks goods

parts.note: SOS is the distress signal
to supplement is to add

explanation.surface: A cry for help about restocking vitamin supplements, aimed at tedious folk.
explanation.definitionFit: Saddos is British slang for pitiable, socially inept people with dreary lives.

clue.text: Suffers since one's confined by nurse turning up

parts.note: ago, as in 'long since' or 'long ago', means in the past

indicators.note: confined by means kept within, so one piece sits inside the other
in a down clue, turning up means the word is read upwards, i.e. backwards

parts.note: SEN is State Enrolled Nurse, a former British nursing grade
one's is read as one is, I + IS, here giving IS

explanation.surface: A patient suffers because they are kept in by a nurse who has turned up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Since' looks like a link word but supplies the first letters; 'turning up' reverses the nurse to NES, and 'confined by' sets IS inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To agonise is to suffer anguish, so agonises matches suffers as a third-person verb.

clue.text: Sport's first couple present field

indicators.note: the first couple of letters of the word Sport's are taken

parts.note: present, as in attendance, means here

explanation.surface: The first couple of a sport are present on the playing field.
explanation.definitionFit: A sphere is a field of activity or influence, as in one's sphere of expertise.

clue.text: Dispensable after ignoring writers with small handicaps

indicators.note: after ignoring means the word is taken once some letters are left out

parts.note: pens are writing implements, so writers
S is the abbreviation for small, as in clothing sizes

explanation.surface: Something dispensable once writers with minor handicaps are overlooked.
explanation.definitionFit: To disable is to handicap, so disables is the verb form matching handicaps.

clue.text: Sources of energy topped up in case

indicators.note: the sources of words are their opening letters, so take the first of each

explanation.surface: Spare energy supplies topped up in a case, like batteries recharged.
explanation.definitionFit: An etui is a small ornamental case for needles or cosmetics, a crossword staple.

clue.text: Put a stop to golf after the girl's affair

indicators.note: after places stop and golf behind the girl

parts.note: the girl is she, with the 's read as a link
to ban something puts a stop to it
G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone ends their golf after the girl's dalliance comes out.
explanation.definitionFit: The whole shebang means the whole business or matter, so shebang is an affair or thing.

clue.text: Keen — before rehearsal shows cheating

indicators.note: before places the first piece ahead of the second

parts.note: keen as in a keen edge means sharp
a rehearsal is practice

explanation.surface: An eager performer shows dishonesty before a rehearsal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharp practice is dishonest dealing that is barely legal, i.e. cheating.

clue.text: Shipping line artist

definitions.meaning: on a boat, the rope at the bow used to tie it up
someone who makes pictures in oils or watercolour

explanation.definitionFit: A painter is both a mooring rope on a small boat and an artist working with paint.

clue.text: Golf article on notice for twenty-four hours

parts.note: a round is one game of golf
the is the definite article
to clock something is slang for to notice it

explanation.surface: A golf story printed on a notice board all day long.
explanation.definitionFit: Round the clock means continuously, all day and all night.

clue.text: Loads of hair worn up in a ball

indicators.note: in puts the hairstyle within a ball

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance
a bun is hair gathered up on the head

explanation.surface: Plenty of hair piled up for a society ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Abundance is a plentiful supply, as is loads, both nouns for a great quantity.

clue.text: All the best gold used to plate stamp

indicators.note: plating covers something in metal, so the gold sits around the stamp

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold
a die is a tool for stamping coins or medals

explanation.surface: A farewell wish while gold is used to plate a stamp, as at a mint.
explanation.definitionFit: Adieu is a French farewell, like the parting phrase all the best.

clue.text: Left amongst friends becomes less interesting

indicators.note: amongst places the letter among the friends

parts.note: pals are friends

explanation.surface: Someone left out among friends finds the company growing dull.
explanation.definitionFit: When something palls it loses its appeal and grows tiresome.

clue.text: Musicians from south are inclined to tour Mediterranean island

indicators.note: touring goes all round, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: to tend to do something is to be inclined to it
Elba is the island where Napoleon was exiled

explanation.surface: Southern musicians plan a tour of Elba.
explanation.definitionFit: A steel band is a group of musicians playing steel drums, from Caribbean tradition.

clue.text: Crime that strangely must keep one school subject

indicators.note: keeping something means holding it inside
strangely signals the letters are rearranged into an odd order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An odd crime involving a single school subject.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strangely' rearranges CRIMETHAT to ARTHMETC, and 'must keep' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Arithmetic, the study of numbers and sums, is a core subject taught in schools.

clue.text: Repeats, needing time for Planck's first formulae

indicators.note: for means one letter takes the place of another

parts.note: to recite is to repeat aloud from memory

indicators.note: first means the opening letter of the physicist's name

explanation.surface: A physicist repeats his formulae, needing time for Planck's constant.
explanation.definitionFit: Recipes are formulae for preparing dishes, or methods for achieving something.

clue.text: Close up before crowd fragment

indicators.note: before places the first piece ahead of the second
in a down clue, up means the word is read upwards, i.e. backwards

parts.note: to stop is to close
a herd is a crowd

explanation.surface: Close up, ahead of a crowd, something breaks into pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A potsherd is a broken piece of pottery, a fragment found by archaeologists.

clue.text: Grass residue is found in two hotels

indicators.note: found in means placed inside the two letters

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet, twice over
ash is the residue of burning

explanation.surface: Cannabis residue discovered in two hotel rooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Grass is slang for cannabis, and hashish is a resin form of the same drug.

clue.text: Use this in garden and expect to receive fresh pies

indicators.note: receiving means taking something inside

parts.note: to hope is to expect

indicators.note: fresh signals the letters made anew in a new order

explanation.surface: A gardener's tool, and a hope of fresh pies to come.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a whole instruction rather than a noun: the thing you use in the garden. 'fresh' rearranges the pies to SEPI, which 'to receive' places inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A gardener waters plants with a long flexible tube attached to a tap.

clue.text: Prisoner regrets crossing street, and explains

indicators.note: crossing means the street lies across the join, with pieces either side

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner
to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: A prisoner, sorry for crossing the street, explains himself.
explanation.definitionFit: To construe is to interpret or explain the meaning of words.

clue.text: Unexpected results from leading groups

parts.note: up means ahead, as a team is up by two goals
sets are groups

explanation.surface: Surprising match results come from the leading groups.
explanation.definitionFit: Upsets are surprise results in sport when a favourite loses.

clue.text: A medical professional contracted to cover hospital for a specific purpose

indicators.note: contracted to cover means hired to surround, so the doctor goes around the hospital

parts.note: doc is short for doctor, a medical professional

explanation.surface: A doctor on contract covers hospital shifts for one particular need.
explanation.definitionFit: Ad hoc is Latin for 'to this', describing something arranged only for a particular need.

clue.text: The drink of a married woman who's educated?

parts.note: Rita is the heroine of the play and film Educating Rita

explanation.surface: Musing on what an educated married woman drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: In Hindu myth, amrita is the nectar of immortality drunk by the gods.

clue.text: European flower west of Hamburg

parts.note: the iris is a flower

indicators.note: the west of a word written left to right is its first letter

explanation.surface: A European flower grown just west of Hamburg.
explanation.definitionFit: The Irish are people from Ireland, a European nation.

clue.text: Sales spiel must start late and cause irritation

indicators.note: starting late means the opening letter is skipped

parts.note: a sales pitch is a spiel

explanation.surface: A sales spiel delayed at the start annoys the audience.
explanation.definitionFit: To itch is to irritate or cause a prickly urge, as in an itchy jumper.

clue.text: Policeman confronting the girl's love for Batman perhaps

parts.note: super is short for superintendent, a senior police officer
the girl's is her, the possessive
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A policeman faces a woman's passion for Batman.
explanation.definitionFit: Batman is an example of a caped crime-fighting comic-book hero with special abilities.

clue.text: Passage that's right in bar

indicators.note: in places the letter inside the other word

parts.note: bar as a preposition means except

explanation.surface: A passage claiming it is right to be in a bar.
explanation.definitionFit: An excerpt is a passage quoted from a longer text or piece of music.

clue.text: Name a fool after the second of April

indicators.note: after places the letters behind the pick
the second of means the second letter of the word April

parts.note: to fool someone is to trick them

explanation.surface: Naming a fool just after April Fools' Day, the first of April.
explanation.definitionFit: Patrick is a man's given name, so it is a name.
